dialogue.origin: こんばんは、21時からよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I look forward to speaking with you from 9 p.m.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you, likewise.

dialogue.origin: それでは始めます。
dialogue.content: Then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Good evening, this is your counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 初めにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16歳の女です
dialogue.content: I'm a 16-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 学年は高校1年生でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you in your first year of high school?

dialogue.origin: そうですよろしくお願いします(´･･`)
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. It's nice to meet you. (´･･`)

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねこちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I see. It's nice to meet you as well.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 彼氏と別れて、つらくて仕方ないです(ToT)
dialogue.content: I broke up with my boyfriend, and it's unbearably painful. (ToT)

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I'm sorry to hear that.

dialogue.origin: 悲しい思いをされましたね
dialogue.content: You must be feeling very sad.

dialogue.origin: 別れたのはいつ頃のことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: When did you break up?

dialogue.origin: 昨日です…
dialogue.content: Yesterday...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もうまじ死にたいです.....
dialogue.content: I seriously want to die.....

dialogue.origin: それほどショックだったのですね
dialogue.content: It must have been a huge shock for you.

dialogue.origin: もの凄く好きだったんですね
dialogue.content: You must have loved him very much.
Yes....

dialogue.origin: 結婚しようって言ってたのに
dialogue.content: Even though we talked about getting married.

dialogue.origin: そこまでお付き合いが進んでいたんですね
dialogue.content: Your relationship had progressed that far, hadn't it?
Yes....

dialogue.origin: それなのに別れてしまったなんて・・・辛すぎますよね
dialogue.content: To break up after all that... it must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.origin: もうずっと泣いてます…
dialogue.content: I've been crying nonstop...

dialogue.origin: 泣いてしまうのも自然なことだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's only natural to cry.

dialogue.origin: どんなことで別れてしまったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What led to the breakup?

dialogue.origin: 浮気されました …
dialogue.content: He cheated on me...

dialogue.origin: えっ結婚の話まで出ていたのに・・・
dialogue.content: What? Even though you had talked about marriage...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです.....最低ですよね😭
dialogue.content: I know... He's the worst, isn't he? 😭

dialogue.origin: それを知ったときどんな気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you found out?

dialogue.origin: 裏切られたって思いました
dialogue.content: I felt betrayed.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: 私の何が悪かったんでしょうか …
dialogue.content: What was wrong with me...?

dialogue.origin: ゆくゆくは結婚しようと話していたのに、浮気するなんて
dialogue.content: To cheat on you when you were talking about getting married in the future...

dialogue.origin: まじ最低ですよね！
dialogue.content: He's seriously the worst, right?!

dialogue.origin: そう思うのは当然のことですよ
dialogue.content: It's completely natural for you to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: でもめっちゃ好きだったんで、信じられないです....
dialogue.content: But I loved him so much, I can't believe it....

dialogue.origin: あなたは悪くなんかないです裏切る方が悪いにきまっていますよ
dialogue.content: You're not at fault at all. The one who betrays is definitely in the wrong.

dialogue.origin: めっちゃ好きだった人が浮気してるなんて信じたくないですよね
dialogue.content: It's hard to believe that someone you loved so much would cheat, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことから、浮気に気付いたんですか？
dialogue.content: How did you find out he was cheating?

dialogue.origin: 彼氏の車に女のピアス落ちてて
dialogue.content: I found a woman's earring in his car.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Go on.

dialogue.origin: その後、携帯覗いたら、ばっちり浮気してました
dialogue.content: After that, I looked at his phone, and it was clear he was cheating.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 最悪です
dialogue.content: It's the worst.

dialogue.origin: 携帯のやり取りをみてしまったんですね
dialogue.content: So you ended up seeing their messages on his phone.
Yes....

dialogue.origin: 辛かったですよね
dialogue.content: That must have been very painful.

dialogue.origin: はい.....もう誰も信じられないです......
dialogue.content: Yes..... I can't trust anyone anymore......

dialogue.origin: 信頼している人に裏切られたら、誰も信じられないって思うのも無理ないです
dialogue.content: When you're betrayed by someone you trust, it's understandable to feel like you can't trust anyone.

dialogue.origin: 今、彼が目に前にいたらどんなことを言いたいですか？
dialogue.content: If he were in front of you right now, what would you want to say to him?

dialogue.origin: 私の何がいけなかったの？って
dialogue.content: 'What was wrong with me?'

dialogue.origin: 実際、聞きましたけどごめんってしか言ってくれませんでした....
dialogue.content: I actually asked him, but all he said was, "I'm sorry"...

dialogue.origin: そっかー
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ごめんって言われてどう思いましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when he just said 'sorry'?

dialogue.origin: 私と話す気ないんだって思いました
dialogue.content: I felt like he didn't even want to talk to me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだちゃんと話をして欲しかったですね
dialogue.content: I see. You wanted him to talk to you properly.

dialogue.origin: もうしばらく学校とかも行きたくないです....立ち直れないですよ
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school or anything for a while... I can't get over this.

dialogue.origin: あなたのお話を伺って、そう感じられるのももっともなことだと思いました
dialogue.content: Listening to your story, I think it's completely reasonable for you to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、その彼はどういう人なんですか？同じ学校の人とか、社会人とか
dialogue.content: By the way, what kind of person is he? Is he at the same school, or a working adult?

dialogue.origin: バイトで一緒だった大学生です
dialogue.content: He's a university student I worked with at my part-time job.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.
Yes....

dialogue.origin: バイトの方は今はどうされていますか？
dialogue.content: How is the part-time job situation now?

dialogue.origin: 私はまだやってますけど、彼は先月辞めました…家庭教師のバイトをはじめるとかで
dialogue.content: I'm still working there, but he quit last month... he said he was starting a tutoring job or something.

dialogue.origin: 会わずに済むのですね
dialogue.content: So you don't have to see him anymore.

dialogue.origin: はい、会いたくても会えないですね....
dialogue.content: Yes, I can't see him even if I wanted to...

dialogue.origin: そっかーそんなに辛い思いをされても、まだ好きなんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So even after being hurt so much, you still love him.

dialogue.origin: はい😭
dialogue.content: Yes. 😭

dialogue.origin: 気持ちってそんなに簡単に切り替えられないですものね
dialogue.content: Feelings can't be turned off that easily, can they?

dialogue.origin: そっかーしばらく辛い思いが続くかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. This painful feeling might continue for a while.

dialogue.origin: そういう気持ちを聴いてもらえるお友達とかはいそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any friends who you could talk to about these feelings?

dialogue.origin: はいもうLINEしてて、みんな、そんな男忘れろって言ってくれますけど...
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been messaging them on LINE, and everyone tells me to forget a guy like that, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: すごい好きだし、どうしたらいいかわからないです....
dialogue.content: I love him so much, and I don't know what to do...

dialogue.origin: 忘れろと言われてもすぐには忘れられませんよね
dialogue.content: It's not easy to forget someone just because you're told to, is it?

dialogue.origin: はい😢
dialogue.content: Yes. 😢

dialogue.origin: そういうところも解ってくれる人がいるといいんですけどね
dialogue.content: It would be nice if there were someone who understood that part of it, too.

dialogue.origin: みんな、いい子だけど、全員彼氏とラブラブだから、なんか逆に悲しくなりそう😭
dialogue.content: They're all good people, but they're all lovey-dovey with their boyfriends, so it kind of makes me feel sadder. 😭

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: みんながラブラブ・・・ですか
dialogue.content: So everyone is 'lovey-dovey'...

dialogue.origin: 今のあなたにはしんどいですね
dialogue.content: That must be hard for you right now.

dialogue.origin: クリスマスとかも、ぼっちかも
dialogue.content: I'll probably be alone for Christmas, too.

dialogue.origin: つらくなってきた…
dialogue.content: I'm starting to feel sad again...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 昨日のことなので、今のあなたは強いショ状態なのだと思います
dialogue.content: Since it only happened yesterday, I believe you are in a state of severe shock right now.

dialogue.origin: はい😢
dialogue.content: Yes. 😢

dialogue.origin: これまでのお話をまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたには将来結婚を考えている彼氏がいた
dialogue.content: You had a boyfriend you were considering marrying in the future.
Yes....

dialogue.origin: ところがその彼が他の女性と付き合っていることを知って、昨日別れてしまった
dialogue.content: However, you found out that he was seeing another woman, and you broke up yesterday.

dialogue.origin: そうです...
dialogue.content: That's right...

dialogue.origin: 自分のどこが悪かったのかを聞いても話してもらえず
dialogue.content: When you asked what you did wrong, he wouldn't talk about it.
Yes....

dialogue.origin: どうしたらよかったのかもわからない
dialogue.content: You don't know what you could have done differently.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 友達に話すと、そんな人は忘れた方がいいと言われるけれど
dialogue.content: When you talk to your friends, they say you should forget about someone like him, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まだ好きなので忘れることなど無理だ
dialogue.content: But you still love him, so it's impossible to forget him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 立ち直れず、学校にもいきたくない
dialogue.content: You can't get over it, and you don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいのかわからない
dialogue.content: You don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: ということで、よろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Does that sound accurate?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 結婚の話をするほど信頼していた人に裏切られたことで、本当に辛い思いをされていることと思います
dialogue.content: I imagine you must be feeling truly hurt, having been betrayed by someone you trusted enough to talk about marriage with.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたはその彼のことを本当に愛していたからこそ、今強いショックを受けていらっしゃるのだと思います
dialogue.content: I believe you're in such a state of shock right now precisely because you truly loved him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なので、浮気されたと知ったいまでも、彼のことを好きでたまらないのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's why, even after finding out he cheated, you can't help but still love him, isn't that right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね...
dialogue.content: I guess so...

dialogue.origin: 気持ちは急には変わりませんよね
dialogue.content: Feelings don't change overnight, do they?

dialogue.origin: はい..
dialogue.content: Yes..

dialogue.origin: なので、しばらくは辛い思いが続くかもしれませんが、
dialogue.content: So, you may continue to feel this pain for a while, but...

dialogue.origin: 今のショック状態が徐々に穏やかになっていったとき、彼が浮気したことに対しての感じ方がまた変わってくるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: as this state of shock gradually subsides, the way you feel about him cheating might also change.

dialogue.origin: そうですか....わかりましたありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Is that so... I understand. Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談にきてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ聴いてくれてありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: No, thank you for listening to me!

dialogue.origin: それでは今日の相談を終わらせていただきます
dialogue.content: Then we will conclude today's session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （遅くなってしまい済みませんでした）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry for the delay.)

dialogue.origin: （とんでもございません！勉強になりました！ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Not at all! It was a great learning experience! Thank you so much!)

dialogue.origin: （忌憚のないご意見をお待ちしています。それではロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (I welcome your frank feedback. May we end the role-play now?)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you!)

topic.sub: 別れた理由に関する悩み
